entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: A Human former planeswalker and sand-mage from Amonkhet, a paladin devoted to Oketra who became the plane's champion folk hero.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: Amonkhet's god of Solidarity, whose teachings Basri follows; she is dead when he returns.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Basri's home plane, left a smoking ruin after the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: Vizier, chosen of Oketra, entombed after his death as an Eternal; Basri seeks to revive him.

entities.name: Mahitab
entities.description: Basri's crop-mate who helps find Temmet's tomb.

entities.name: Niharet
entities.description: Basri's crop-mate who betrays them, aligned with the old gods.

entities.name: Marunaten
entities.description: Teenage embalmer brought to revive Temmet.

entities.name: Merinaten
entities.description: Teenage embalmer brought to revive Temmet.

entities.name: Munhatep
entities.description: Ancient pharaoh of the Chitin Court who confronts the group at the tomb.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: A new god summoned by Basri's faith in Oketra who destroys the Chitin Court warriors and bears Temmet's body to Naktamun.

entities.name: Sab-Sunen
entities.description: Another new god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: Undead Leonin whose tomb Basri discovers and awakens; crosses the Grand Prix finish line first.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god for whom Basri's team rides.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: Faction of ancient pharaohs and warriors opposed to Basri.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City Basri works to unite under a strong leader.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The catastrophe that left Amonkhet in ruins.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which Basri lost his planeswalking abilities.

entities.name: Trial of Solidarity
entities.description: Oketra's trial Basri completed, igniting his spark.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: A race in which Basri leads the Amonkheti delegation.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: Prize won by Basri's team at the Grand Prix.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders Basri fended off alongside the living and the dead.

events.summary: Basri completes Oketra's Trial of Solidarity, shielding his crop with sand; his spark ignites and he is carried to another plane.
events.quote: Basri's latent Planeswalker's spark ignited and he found himself on another plane

events.summary: Basri returns to Amonkhet to find it a smoking ruin and Oketra dead.
events.quote: Oketra was dead, and everything he had believed turned out to be an elaborate lie.

events.summary: After a crisis of faith, Basri rallies the injured and realizes Oketra's teachings still live on.
events.quote: He rounded up the injured and weary, encouraged them with what he knew

events.summary: Basri loses his planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening.
events.quote: he lost his planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening .

events.summary: Basri sets out with Mahitab, Niharet and two embalmers across the desert to find Temmet's tomb to revive him.
events.quote: They set off across the desert, surviving an attack from a sandwurm , and reached the tomb.

events.summary: At the tomb Munhatep confronts them and Niharet betrays them; the new god Ketramose, summoned by Basri's faith, destroys the Chitin Court warriors and bears Temmet's body to Naktamun.
events.quote: He destroyed the Chitin Court warriors and bore Temmet's body back to Naktamun.

events.summary: Basri discovers Zahur's tomb on an expedition and performs the rites to awaken him.
events.quote: Basri discovered Zahur 's tomb and performed the rites to awaken him.

events.summary: Basri leads the Amonkheti delegation in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix with Zahur; Zahur crosses the finish line first, winning the Aetherspark.
events.quote: Zahur would be the first to cross the finish line, winning the Aetherspark for the team.

relations.quote: He used to be a paladin devoted to Oketra

relations.note: Betrayed the group, aligned with the old gods.
relations.quote: betrayed by Niharet, who was also aligned with the old gods

relations.note: Summoned by his faith, he saves the group.
relations.quote: a new god summoned by Basri's faith in Oketra

relations.note: Awakened Zahur and teams with him in the Grand Prix.
relations.quote: Basri led the Amonkheti delegation in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix alongside the undead Leonin Zahur
